body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates the console’s Page/Dashboard editing flow to keep users in-context by opening a reusable right-side `DesignDrawer` (Shadcn `Sheet`) with lazy-loaded editors, enabling real-time preview while editing and preserving the existing `/design/*` routes.

**Changes:**
- Added a reusable `DesignDrawer` component with auto-save + Ctrl/Cmd+S save behavior.
- Updated `PageView` and `DashboardView` edit buttons to open the drawer and preview live schema edits.
- Added a new test suite for the drawer behavior and updated `ROADMAP.md` to mark the feature complete.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/PageView.tsx | Replaces navigation-to-design with opening `DesignDrawer` + live preview via local `editSchema`. |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Same drawer-based editing + live preview for dashboards. |
| apps/console/src/components/DesignDrawer.tsx | New reusable Sheet-based drawer with auto-save and Ctrl/Cmd+S shortcut. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/DesignDrawer.test.tsx | Tests drawer open, editor rendering, live preview sync, auto-save, Ctrl+S, and no-navigation for PageView. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the right-side drawer and tests as completed work. |
</details>

`drawerOpen`/`editSchema` state is not reset when `pageName` changes. Because React Router reuses the same `PageView` instance for different `:pageName` values, navigating to another page while the drawer is open can preview the *previous* page schema and even persist it to the *new* `recordName` via `DesignDrawer` (wrong record update). Consider closing the drawer and clearing `editSchema` in an effect keyed on `pageName` (and/or keying the drawer/page view by `pageName`).

`drawerOpen`/`editSchema` state is not reset when `dashboardName` changes. Since `DashboardView` is reused across `dashboard/:dashboardName`, navigating to a different dashboard while the drawer is open can keep previewing the previous schema and may call `dataSource.update` with the new `recordName` but an old schema. Consider closing the drawer and clearing `editSchema` in an effect keyed on `dashboardName`.

`useState` is imported but never used in this file. Removing the unused import will avoid lint/TS warnings.
```suggestion
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
```

`DesignDrawerProps` uses `any` for `schema`, `onSchemaChange`, and the render-prop, which loses type safety compared to the strongly-typed `PageSchema`/`DashboardSchema` usage elsewhere. Consider making `DesignDrawer` generic (e.g., `<T extends PageSchema | DashboardSchema>`) so `schema`, `onSchemaChange`, and `children` all share the same type.

`container` is declared but unused in this test. Remove the unused variable to avoid lint warnings and keep the test focused.
```suggestion
    renderPageView();
```
